selection: GitHub-reviewed pip advisories with CWE-200/201/209/359/532 (397 on 21 Oct 2026), filtered to a secret field reaching a response, log or payload in Python code with a linked fix commit, then chosen to cover different leak shapes. Labels come from each advisory: the fix commit's first parent leaks, the fix commit does not. Selected before any Unspool run.
